batch: 2026-11-13 地推路线 · Old Klang Road / OUG / Kuchai Lama / Bangsar
source: sales/leads/2026-11-13-visit.json（俊宇要地推：Old Klang Road、Mid Valley、Sri Petaling、KL Sentral、Bangsar；来源网址写在每家的 input 里）

leads.name: 80s Home Cook Cuisine
leads.contact_source: Malay Mail 2026-01 食评：订位只收 WhatsApp，同时列出 IG
leads.address: 27 & 29, Jalan 2/115A, Taman Pagar Ruyong, off Jalan Kuchai Lama, KL
leads.why: Kuchai Lama 的 80 年代家常菜，酿乳猪糯米卷 RM298、芝麻脆皮鸡 RM138；Malay Mail 说要等两个月才有位子，订位只靠 WhatsApp。
leads.verify: 傍晚 6 点开门前去比较好（星期一休息）；看他们有没有做农历新年外带 / 预订乳猪。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: 1980s-style Chinese home-cook restaurant at 27 & 29 Jalan 2/115A, Taman Pagar Ruyong, off Jalan Kuchai Lama, KL. Signature: Crispy Suckling Pig Sticky Rice Roll (RM298), 1980s-Style Sesame Crispy Chicken (RM138). Open Tue–Sun 6–10.30pm.
Signals: Malay Mail review (11 Jan 2026) headlined 'a two-month wait for a table'; the rest of January and February were fully booked at the time.
Budget signal: Signature dishes RM138–RM298; table bookings weeks ahead.
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh 80shomecook, the80shomecookcuisine, 80shomecookcuisine → NONE. (b) No website or online ordering found in search; reservations by WhatsApp only. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: IG @the80shomecookcuisine; WhatsApp 016-290 9233 (reservations, per Malay Mail Jan 2026).
Observation: Malay Mail (Jan 2026): 'Stuffed suckling pig, sesame crispy chicken and a two-month wait for a table'; the restaurant is loud, rowdy and vibrant.
Angle: A booking page that takes dates, party size and a deposit (fewer WhatsApp back-and-forths), plus pre-orders for the suckling pig and Chinese New Year takeaway sets with a cut-off date.
Sources: https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2026/01/11/stuffed-suckling-pig-sesame-crispy-chicken-and-a-two-month-wait-for-a-table-does-kuchai-lamas-80s-home-cook-cuisine-live-up-to-the-hype/205022

leads.name: Soon Heng Social Club
leads.contact_source: Malay Mail 2026-07 食评列出电话和 IG
leads.address: 32A, Jalan Sepadu, Taman United (OUG), off Old Klang Road, KL
leads.why: Taman United 的复古华人俱乐部风格西餐（牛排、油封鸭、猪扒），人均 RM50–100；Malay Mail 2026-07 报道，没有网站。
leads.verify: 傍晚 5:30 开门（星期三到星期日）；跟 Caleb's Hideout 在同一条街，可以一起去。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Retro Chinese social-club themed Western restaurant (steak, duck confit, pork chops) at 32A Jalan Sepadu, Taman United, off Old Klang Road, KL. Non-halal. Open Wed–Sun 5.30–11pm.
Signals: Malay Mail review (17 Jul 2026): 'Soon Heng Social Club in Taman United delivers substance in style'; Chiefeater listing.
Budget signal: About RM50–RM100 per person (Chiefeater).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh soonhengsocialclub → NONE; soonheng → soonheng.com.my is a vehicle repair company (not theirs). (b) No website or online ordering found in search. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: IG @soonheng_; phone 018-668 7204 (Malay Mail, Jul 2026).
Observation: Malay Mail (Jul 2026) on steak, duck confit and pork chops in a retro-themed Chinese social club.
Angle: Table bookings that arrive with date, time and party size; festive set menus (Christmas, CNY reunion) and gift vouchers sold online.
Sources: https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2026/07/17/steak-duck-confit-and-pork-chops-in-a-retro-themed-chinese-social-club-soon-heng-social-club-in-taman-united-delivers-substance-in-style/227893 ; https://chiefeater.com/best-eats-in-taman-united/

leads.name: Caleb's Hideout
leads.contact_source: Malay Mail 2026-09 食评列出电话和 IG
leads.address: 24-1, Jalan Sepadu, Taman United (OUG), off Old Klang Road, KL
leads.why: 营养师开的花园咖啡馆，做「好吃但比较健康」的蛋糕（豆腐燕麦奶巧克力慕斯）；Malay Mail 2026-09 报道。整颗蛋糕的价钱还没查到。
leads.verify: 只开星期五、六、日；问他们有没有接整颗蛋糕 / 节日订单，价钱多少。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Dietitian-designed garden café at 24-1 Jalan Sepadu, Taman United (OUG), off Old Klang Road, KL. Cakes and coffee; signature tofu oat milk chocolate mousse cake. Open Fri & Sun 9am–6pm, Sat 9am–10pm.
Signals: Malay Mail review (12 Sep 2026): 'a dietitian-designed garden café in OUG for indulgent yet guilt-free cakes & coffee'.
Budget signal: Physical café plus media coverage; whole-cake prices not published (B: evidence of spend not confirmed).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh calebshideout, calebs-hideout → NONE. (b) No website or online ordering found in search. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: IG @caleb.hideout; phone 018-317 0986 (Malay Mail, Sep 2026).
Observation: Malay Mail (Sep 2026) on the tofu oat milk chocolate mousse cake and the garden setting.
Angle: Whole-cake pre-orders with pick-up dates (birthdays, Christmas), a 'healthier cakes' story page from a dietitian.
Sources: https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2026/09/12/escape-to-calebs-hideout-a-dietitian-designed-garden-cafe-in-oug-for-indulgent-yet-guilt-free-cakes-coffee/234897

leads.name: Oui Bakehouse & Café
leads.contact_source: Malay Mail 2024-11 食评列出电话（座机）和 IG
leads.address: G02, Menara K1, Lorong 3/137C, Old Klang Road, KL
leads.why: Old Klang Road Menara K1 楼下的法式烘焙咖啡馆，2023 年开，Malay Mail 2024-11 报道；只有座机，没有网站。
leads.verify: 只有座机：去的时候拿老板的 WhatsApp；看他们有没有接整颗蛋糕 / 圣诞订单。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: French-inspired bakery café at G02 Menara K1, Lorong 3/137C, Old Klang Road, KL. Cruffins, cinnamon rolls, pastries, brunch (Country Steak Sandwich, French toast). Open daily 9am–6pm (Nov 2024).
Signals: Opened Feb 2023 (Eat Drink KL); Malay Mail review (30 Nov 2024) called it 'a hidden gem off Old Klang Road'.
Budget signal: Physical bakery café with brunch menu and media coverage; prices not confirmed (B).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh ouibakehouse, ouibakehousecafe → NONE. (b) No website or online ordering found in search. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: IG @ouibakehousecafe; landline 03-7770 9355 (Malay Mail, Nov 2024). No public mobile number found.
Observation: Malay Mail (Nov 2024) on the Country Steak Sandwich and fancy French toast.
Angle: Pastry and whole-cake pre-orders with pick-up times; Christmas and CNY boxes; office catering orders from the Menara K1 tower.
Sources: https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2024/11/30/for-steak-sandwiches-fancy-french-toast-and-other-brunch-favourites-drop-by-oui-bakehouse-cafe-a-hidden-gem-off-old-klang-road/158430 ; https://www.eatdrinkkl.com/posts/snapshot/oui-bakehouse-cafe-old-klang-road

leads.name: Tangram
leads.contact_source: Malay Mail 2026-01 食评列出 WhatsApp 和 IG（Buro247 2026-01 列的是 012-266 2548）
leads.why: Bangsar Telawi 3 的台湾风味精致餐厅，午餐 RM98 起、晚餐 RM298 起；Malay Mail、The Edge 2026 年都报道过，没有网站。
leads.verify: 两个号码不一样（Malay Mail 012-586 6642、Buro247 012-266 2548）：去的时候确认；晚上 6 点开门前去。
leads.input:
What they sell / Location: Modern Asian / Taiwanese-inspired restaurant at 61 Jalan Telawi 3, Bangsar Baru, KL. Open Mon–Sat (lunch noon–3pm per The Edge; dinner 6–11pm).
Signals: Malay Mail review (9 Jan 2026): 'confident cooking, excellent service inspired by Taiwanese classics'; Options/The Edge review (Jun 2026); Buro247 new openings (Jan 2026).
Budget signal: Lunch from RM98, dinner from RM298 (The Edge, Jun 2026).
Website check: (a) check-domains.sh tangramkl, tangram-kl → NONE. (b) No website or booking page found in search; Malay Mail lists WhatsApp. (c) No other brand found.
Contacts: IG @tangram_kl; WhatsApp +6012-586 6642 (Malay Mail, Jan 2026); Buro247 lists +6012 266 2548.
Observation: The Edge (Jun 2026): 'Tangram in Bangsar rearranges familiar Asian flavours into dishes marked by finesse and fun'.
Angle: Reservations with deposits for the RM298 dinner, private dining and festive menus, gift vouchers (like our Maison Cendre demo).
Sources: https://www.malaymail.com/news/eat-drink/2026/01/09/tangram-brings-confident-cooking-excellent-service-inspired-by-taiwanese-classics-to-bangsar/204769 ; https://www.optionstheedge.com/node/4955
